intro: Quick answers to what people ask most about GTA 6, especially players in India.

items.q: What time does GTA 6 unlock in India?
items.a: 12:00 AM IST on Thursday 19 November 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. That's about 10 hours before players in the US can start.

items.q: How much does GTA 6 cost in India?
items.a: ₹5,999 for the Standard Edition and ₹7,499 for the Ultimate Edition on the PlayStation Store.
Not at launch, and Rockstar hasn't announced a PC date. Past Rockstar games reached PC 9 to 18 months after consoles.
Not at launch. Rockstar calls GTA 6 a single-player experience and hasn't announced an online mode. Any dates you see are rumours.

items.q: Does the physical edition come with a disc?
items.a: No. Boxed copies contain a download code instead of a disc.

items.q: Can I still get the pre-order bonus?
items.a: The Vintage Vice City Pack comes with every digital purchase made before 20 November 2026, and with boxed copies while stocks last.

items.q: Is the Ultimate Edition worth it?
items.a: It adds 16 extras: cars, weapons, outfits, shops and two side activities. Nothing in it is needed to finish the game, so Standard is enough if you only care about the story.

items.q: How many wanted stars are there?
items.a: Six, up from five in GTA V.
